answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit jade bond to one numbered harbor berth and files a mooring claim naming that berth. Each epoch a sparrow patrol replays the harbor log and burns any bond whose berth is double-moored, whose claim is rented, or whose pulse never arrived. First filing 42, the k-th 42+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked, far above the 40,000 pool. An honest agent moors once, pays 42 once, keeps its share.
